summary: Stardust Power Inc. filed an 8-K on August 21, 2026 disclosing that holder Lind Global Asset Management XIII LLC delivered a notice of conversion and default under the company's 2025 Senior Secured Convertible Note. Lind converted $150,000 of principal at $0.492 per share, and on August 20, 2026 Stardust issued 304,878 shares under Section 3(a)(9). The conversion was triggered by a market-capitalization default, after the company's market cap stayed below $15.0 million for ten consecutive trading days. Following the conversion, $3,430,000 of principal remains outstanding and 14,523,933 shares are issued and outstanding, before any default-related mandatory amounts. Watch for further conversions, dilution, and potential acceleration or default remedies given the continuing event of default.
